capabilities: Export notes to Word, PDF, LaTeX, HTML, EPUB and other formats
Import documents and convert them into notes
Configure Pandoc options through a graphical template editor
Install and manage Lua filters from a built-in store
Convert on mobile using Pandoc WASM
extras: Free plugin. Makes disclosed network calls to api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com and cdn.jsdelivr.net. Pandoc WASM adds about 56 MB to the vault (Typst and fonts about 36 MB more) and syncs with it; mobile export needs iOS 18.4+ or an up-to-date Android WebView. Some Lua filters require external programs (mermaid-cli, lilypond, aspell, Pygments, Node.js). A user guide is available inside the plugin.
intentEvidence: This plugin began as a fork of Enhancing Export by YISH (@mokeyish)
motivation: The author, a Religious Studies scholar, says the plugin helps him in his research and that he uses it in teaching his information-technology course.
problem: Pandoc's full conversion power is normally reachable only through the command line, which many Obsidian users cannot or do not want to use.
